description: This file defines the CallsParseRule class, which extends ActivitiesParseRule, for parsing call-related panels in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for pre-processing panels during the view rendering process, particularly modifying the 'direction' field to 'status' during 'EditView' times.

classes.name: CallsParseRule
classes.description: Class for parsing call-related fields in the SuiteCRM UI, extending ActivitiesParseRule with custom logic for handling panels in views.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Pre-processes panels, replacing 'direction' fields with 'status' in 'EditView' mode.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Delegates panel parsing to the parent method without additional modification.
